responsibility: Public SSE4.1/SSE4.2 intrinsic header for x86, layering on top of SSSE3, SSE3, and SSE2 to expose rounding, blend, test, string-compare, and 64-bit compare operations. It also pulls in POPCNT and CRC32 support so the user-facing API covers the full SSE4.1/SSE4.2 builtin set and related bit-counting helpers.
